title: bug: local runner compares its own projectPath unresolved, so a native alias (//x on POSIX, /x on Windows) refuses its own daemon
description: scripts/local-runner/guest-session.mjs loopbackDaemonHost and vm-control.mjs readDaemonInfo compare canonicalProjectPath(own) without path.resolve, and runner-client.mjs discover uses an exact `info.projectPath !== projectPath`. A native alias of the project therefore reads its own daemon as foreign. That is the same class as task-f33bf7af's proxy and doctor fix (non-destructive refusal; callers usually pass canonical paths). guest-session.mjs:82 also still names the twin as index.ts; the twin now lives in packages/moe-daemon/src/util/projectPath.ts (index.ts re-exports it). Confirm first whether runner-client's exact match is deliberate.
